title: The Quiet Workshop (Sample)
subtitle: Twelve Practical Projects for a Small Home Bench
description: Sample: Chapter 1, "Setting Up the Bench", of a 12-project book in progress.
overview: This sample edition gives you the complete Chapter 1, "Setting Up the Bench," along with the full twelve-chapter contents roadmap for a practical woodworking book built around a small home bench. Inside Chapter 1, Elias Hartwell walks through choosing a corner with steady light, setting a comfortable bench height, placing power and side lighting cleanly, and assembling a single-drawer starter kit of essential hand tools one piece at a time. This is a preview sample, coming soon: a 9-page digital PDF that lets you test the writing, layout, and hands-on approach before the full 12-project book is finished.
author: Elias Hartwell
byline: Elias Hartwell is a pen name. Published by ExpanPress.
